case.summary: Case HHG-004 was initiated following a report from customer C08106 disputing an online transaction of $128.33 on card C08106-K1. The transaction (ID 3583227) occurred on 2016-12-29 01:53:54 and was executed via a newly identified device profile D001320 (Firefox 47.0). The charge significantly exceeds the customer's historical baseline of 209 transactions averaging $35.31 (z=3.3). Based on the customer dispute, device anomaly, and a calibrated fraud probability of 0.93 under the card-not-present pattern, the verdict is confirmed fraud. The card was blocked and the case created, with no SAR filed as exposure remained under $1,000.
